text:
maria: Heads-up — planning a quiet-window deploy tonight 23:00 UTC for runtime + router updates. Affects API routing header logic and console rollout.

sam: which runtime version are we rolling? any pin requirements for dedicated? :thinking_face:

maria: runtime v2.8.1 + router v1.4.0. Console schema change for route metadata (non-breaking but needs console + API to be aligned).

jordan: fyi dedicated pools may see short burst while KV cache warms. Router eviction thresholds could trigger if we hit a hot shard.

linh: can we set a soft pin on the console route until the console schema migration finishes? would avoid partial UI fallout.

maria: yes — propose pin console->v2026.03 for 2h post-deploy, then unpin if metrics look green.

ben: thumbs on rollback criteria? latency > 25% or error rate spike > 1.5% for 5m?

sam: +1 on latency and error thresholds. add 95th pct token latency > 300ms as extra guard for runtime.

ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: wave=final, start=2123456800, owners=[maria,sam], health-checks=[api-50x-rate,router-evictions,cpu-gpu-temp]

deploy-bot: preflight passed on staging. Canary 10% allocs green for 12m. Logs: "no router evictions observed".

jordan: note — router config change is hot reload; if we hit evictions, we can fallback the router to v1.3.9 and let runtime continue.

linh: how do we coordinate console deploy? we want console to follow within 10m of API to avoid 0.0 fields.

maria: plan: API and runtime go in wave, router config follow immediate; console deploy paused behind manual OK from product. manual OK window 00-30m after start.

ben: safe rollback plan: if any health-check trips -> automatic rollback for router, manual rollback for runtime (due to KV warming) with a 3m cool-off before runtime rollback.

sam: document the rollback command here:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/runtime --to-revision=stable-2026
deploy-bot abort --wave final
```

maria: agreed. I'll update release notes with pinned routes, canary results, rollback steps, and TTL for the soft pin.

jordan: add metric to watch: router.evictions.per_minute and runtime.kv.warm_ratio.

deploy-bot: alert rule created: router.evictions > 5 in 5m -> notify #eng-oncall and mute auto-scaler for 2m.

linh: product gave manual OK for console at +8m.

ben: monitoring shows a small latency blip at +6m but within thresholds. keeping eyes on it.

maria: roll-forward. removing console pin in 90m if no regressions. thanks all :tada:
